name: E-Sekai
source:
After a shitty breakup with her womanizer boyfriend, Alice is transported to a game she was playing through an anonymous email link she clicked. 

[Edited from [url=https://chanchangames.itch.io/e-sekai]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
與花心男友慘淡分手後，Alice點選了一封匿名郵件中的連結，結果被傳送進自己正在玩的遊戲裡。

[編譯自[url=https://chanchangames.itch.io/e-sekai]itch.io[/url]]
